none: PAS LANCUM-605BAE: Possibly a nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Extremely worn late Roman issue. Possibly a nummus of House of Constantine, Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, Trier mint, Reece period 17. Obverse description: [Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis with sceptre over shoulder left.]. Obverse inscription: [CONSTAN TINOPOLIS]. Reverse description: Victory standing facing on prow with shield and spear. In exergue: illegible
